objective: Resolve the packed-row mapping left ambiguous by R75 by tracing c2 row 1 with the identical hook and workload.
fixed_workload: Same c2 suite, current R72-derived oracle, output length, cache-zero gate, server shape, and hardware as R74/R75.
validity_gate: cache-c000 must again differ first at token 96, index-c001 must remain exact, and no new GPU/Xe fault may occur.
decision: If row 1 hashes align with the R74 c1 row-0 request sequence, use row 1 for boundary localization; otherwise test the remaining packed row without inferring a boundary.
publication_boundary: Diagnostic only; no performance or quality claim.
